name: 01930 · Gloucester, MA
findings: ZIP 01930 (Gloucester) has 191 nonprofit organizations. 67 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 58 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01930 (Gloucester) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
